mapper.select: SELECT declaration_id AS declarationId, client_application_id AS clientApplicationId, declaration_type AS declarationType, declared_value AS declaredValue, declared_by_account_id AS declaredByAccountId, declared_time AS declaredTime, client_ip AS clientIp, user_agent AS userAgent, terms_version AS termsVersion, create_time AS createTime FROM t_application_declaration WHERE client_application_id=#{applicationId} ORDER BY declared_time, declaration_id
